title: Dr. Planet
description:
Casual and relaxing colony simulation inside the laboratory. Combine different mini-planets and civilizations, then put them into the time simulation device for 1000 years. It may not be long for us humans, but for these little creatures, it's eternity.

 

Features:• Events with multiple choices

• A lot of combinations and ways to play

• Find the right balance between numbers

• 12 different and unique missions

• Sandbox mode is unlocked after completing the game

• Hidden surprises to discover

• Relaxing music

Story:In the distant future, people keep whole mini-civilizations as pets, and they pay a lot of money for them. As an expert in your field, you travel through the galaxy and deliver the best colonies to customers.

 
Note from developerThis is a really casual and relaxing game with occasional events that affect the evolution of a colony. There is no complex management. My idea was to keep it simple and funny at times. I hope it will relax you and make your day better.
description_short: Create mini planets and civilizations. Let them flourish, or let them fall - literally. The choice is yours, Doctor Planet.
